name: inspect_endpoint
description: Connect to a remote MCP endpoint, list its tools, and classify each tool's side effects from its MCP hints. Never calls a tool on the target.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: Absolute http or https URL of the MCP endpoint

arguments.name: headers
arguments.desc: Optional HTTP headers for the target, e.g. Authorization. Never stored.

name: get_pricing
description: MCP Canary plans, monthly prices, and limits, plus the free trial
